authority: Current accepted findings and defect status. Git remains authoritative for source and current HEAD.

known_baseline_failures.claim: validate_good_units.py reports the pre-existing frozen source_provenance/AI RAW.per_sha256 mismatch.
known_baseline_failures.action: Do not silently rebaseline it; it is unrelated to T52 runtime work.

known_baseline_failures.claim: The read-only strategy synchronizer reports six pre-existing generated civilization PER outputs it would update; T53 changed none of the strategy source, generator, or generated civilization files.
known_baseline_failures.action: Keep this unrelated baseline explicit and do not silently regenerate it during the order-706 experiment.

findings.claim: T51's sparse four-cardinal-sector sampler was the first source/runtime boundary for the one-order Shipyard regression; T52 restores the T50 full independent X/Y candidate domain while preserving placement safety and capacity policy.
findings.acceptance: A fresh marker-500 replay shows multiple eligible players progressing to concrete Shipyard foundations without recurring narrow-inlet placement; T51's one-player collapse does not recur.
findings.next_action: Reconstruct codes 524-545 for every eligible deficit before examining later gates.
findings.reopen_when: A fresh replay shows equivalent or worse multi-player admission/placement failure, or source/runtime identity is disproven.

findings.claim: Landed assault slots acquire literal hostile targets, issue the landed writer, rotate targets, and terminate when their groups disappear.
findings.acceptance: T51 runtime reconstructed target acquisition and issuance for all three slots without lease-only expiry.
findings.reopen_when: New direct replay evidence shows a landed group again lacks target acquisition/issuance under the verified runtime.

findings.claim: Independent land trade topology and bounded Trade Cart probes produce live land trade for eligible players.
findings.acceptance: T50 runtime passed and T51 produced Trade Carts for all eight players.
findings.next_action: Preserve; investigate only if new contradictory runtime evidence appears.
findings.reopen_when: A verified runtime with eligible same-zone Markets again produces no live Cart trade.

findings.claim: Automatic migration can admit, board, sail and unload on path-clear same-zone landings without preloaded adoption or manual input.
findings.acceptance: T51 contained twelve autonomous same-second path-clear unloads and no wrong-zone/path-rejected unload.
findings.next_action: Preserve launch/landing while proving productive drop-site behavior separately.
findings.reopen_when: New verified runtime evidence contradicts automatic launch/landing.

findings.claim: Large repeated Villager order-706 streams remain unattributed. T53 audited every source-visible Villager-capable DUC writer and now tests only four explicitly owned ordinary home-economy action-default writers with Ctrl persistence and exact actor correlation.
findings.acceptance: A fresh verified runtime correlates each sampled actor's pre/post/later exact order-706 rate to codes 640-657. The flood materially falls or disappears after a persistent Ctrl retask without protected-behavior regression, or unchanged/worse evidence rejects the experiment without overclaiming a native cause.
findings.next_action: Analyze the next verified marker-501 replay with tools/analyze_economic_retasks.py, classify every sample and major unsampled actor, then retain or independently revert 5ece337 from runtime evidence.

findings.claim: T53 is an experimental behavioral probe: four explicitly owned home-economy action-default writers issue with Ctrl persistence, immediately restore the modifier, and exclude carrying workers at selection and command time.
findings.acceptance: In a verified fresh runtime, sampled assignments persist and the same actor's order-706 rate materially falls or disappears, without carried-resource loss or regression in ordinary economy, explicit safety garrison, migration/assault boarding, construction, repair or combat.
findings.next_action: Await a fresh marker-501 replay; retain only on runtime PASS and otherwise revert 5ece337 independently while preserving e359ea5 diagnostics.
findings.reopen_when: The actor-level order-706 rate is unchanged/worse, the assignment does not persist, or any protected behavior regresses.

findings.claim: Some close, reserved assault passengers keep exact Transport/group/enter intent but fail to complete boarding before bounded preparation terminates.
findings.acceptance: A complete abort episode distinguishes physical blockage, oscillation, reissuance, ownership displacement or genuine inability to enter; the resulting narrow fix preserves successful useful-partial and three-slot dispatch.
findings.next_action: Reconstruct each marker-500 abort rather than increasing timers broadly.

findings.claim: Migration launch and unload are demonstrated, but an autonomous remote drop-site reaching ready state followed by gather and deposit is not yet runtime-proven.
findings.acceptance: Without manual input: exact foundation selection/issue, concrete foundation, code 579 value 2 ready, post-foundation gather writer, and visible intended-resource gather/deposit.
findings.next_action: Trace the first complete marker-500 migration productivity lifecycle; code 579 value 3 is a failed episode.

findings.claim: Merchant right-of-way behavior has not been proven in a natural late-game choke; T51 diagnostics exhausted during empty startup scans.
findings.acceptance: An actual stalled priority hull causes one safe active merchant yield, the hull resumes progress before another clearance, and native trade later resumes.
findings.next_action: Exercise and reconstruct codes 586-637 plus existing yield writers 420/421 in a real choke.

findings.claim: Safe isolated allies may undercommit surplus armies overseas, but upstream Shipyard, preparation, migration and ROW boundaries currently prevent clean policy attribution.
findings.acceptance: After upstream gates pass, a safe isolated player productively fills and reuses the existing three slots from true surplus while retaining an adaptive home reserve.
findings.next_action: Collect blocker-transition/manifest observations only; do not tune until dependencies are judged.

findings.claim: Agent context is separated into bounded hot current state, selectively assembled warm task/subsystem/role metadata, and indexed cold history/evidence; the assembler never concatenates referenced evidence.
findings.acceptance: Context metadata validates, narrow packets remain below 12 KB, hot entry points remain below 30 KB, and cold evidence stays explicitly retrievable without routine ingestion.
findings.next_action: Maintain current IDs/capsules and replace the hot handoff instead of appending history.
findings.reopen_when: A size/selectivity test fails, authoritative state contradicts the handoff, or a representative narrow task again requires broad unrelated reconstruction.

findings.claim: Repository agent routing is an optional capability graph: deterministic tools and the current/built-in worker are the default, while scout, analyst, planner and verifier are conditional, receive bounded packets, return a four-field result, and cannot recursively delegate by default.
findings.acceptance: All project agent TOML validates; representative trivial, maintenance and documentation tasks remain worker-only; optional capabilities have explicit positive and negative gates, bounded capsule roles, compact results and no nested delegation.
findings.next_action: Use economy mode by default and revise a capability only after recurring evidence shows that its maintenance and invocation cost is justified.
findings.reopen_when: Routine tasks begin spawning optional agents, agent prompts drift beyond their bounded contracts, or measured completion cost shows the router increasing total usage.
